/memories/session-01.md:L19: [Image caption: a photo of a building with a sign on the front of it]
/memories/session-01.md:L40: [Image caption: a photo of a living room with a couch, table, and television]
/memories/session-01.md:L58: Calvin: I'm gonna be in Japan for a few months then off to Boston! I can't wait!
/memories/session-01.md:L62: [Image caption: a photography of a park with a lake and a few boats]
/memories/session-02.md:L25: [Image caption: a photo of a red sports car parked on the side of the road]
/memories/session-02.md:L34: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Doing good. Last weekend, I went to a music festival in Boston - it was awesome! So many cool bands playing and the atmosphere was electric. I love music, it reminded me why I love it. Here's a pic, take a look.
/memories/session-02.md:L35: [Image caption: a photo of a large crowd of people at a concert]
/memories/session-02.md:L42: [Image caption: a photo of a concert with a large eagle on the stage]
/memories/session-02.md:L49: [Image caption: a photo of two people on stage with guitars and a microphone]
/memories/session-03.md:L36: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I'm dreaming of touring the world, performing for different people and connecting with them. I hope my music can reach a global audience and make an impact. I'm also looking forward to my upcoming trip to Boston after I finish the Frank Ocean tour. I've heard that the music scene there is awesome, so I can't wait to check it out!
/memories/session-03.md:L39: Dave: Sounds like an amazing plan, Cal! I can't wait for your trip to Boston. I'll show you around town and all the cool spots. The music scene there is awesome, with places like Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park. You'll definitely have some great performances there. Count me in for the front row when you're up onstage! Oh, and by the way, check out this pic.
/memories/session-03.md:L40: [Image caption: a photography of a city skyline with a boat in the water]
/memories/session-03.md:L43: Calvin: Wow, Boston looks great! Thanks for the tips. And, awesome pic!
/memories/session-03.md:L46: Dave: Last weekend I went to a car show. Classic cars are so charming and the dedication people put into restoring them is amazing. That's why I'm so into auto engineering. Can't wait to show you some when you come to Boston! Oh, almost forgot to send a photo, look at this beautiful car!
/memories/session-03.md:L47: [Image caption: a photography of a green mustang parked in a field of grass]
/memories/session-03.md:L50: Calvin: Wow, Dave, that car looks great! Take a look at my car, I put a lot of work into it. Can't wait to see more when I'm in Boston!
/memories/session-03.md:L51: [Image caption: a photo of a red sports car on display at a show]
/memories/session-03.md:L54: Dave: Thanks! It definitely took a lot of work. Have you had a chance to check out Boston apart from the gigs?
/memories/session-04.md:L12: Dave: Hey Calvin, long time no see! A lot's been happening since we last talked. Guess what? I finally opened my own car maintenance shop! It's so satisfying to have a spot to work on cars - it's like a dream come true! Take a look at the photo.
/memories/session-04.md:L13: [Image caption: a photo of a car dealership with cars parked in front of it]
/memories/session-04.md:L17: [Image caption: a photo of a man standing under a car in a garage]
/memories/session-04.md:L24: [Image caption: a photo of a book with a space theme on it]
/memories/session-04.md:L31: [Image caption: a photo of a red car parked in a parking lot]
/memories/session-04.md:L35: [Image caption: a photo of a car engine with a small air filter]
/memories/session-04.md:L65: Dave: I will! By the way, This is a photo of my shop. Come by sometime, if you can!
/memories/session-04.md:L66: [Image caption: a photo of a group of people standing in front of a car]
/memories/session-04.md:L88: [Image caption: a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant]
/memories/session-05.md:L13: [Image caption: a photo of a car being worked on in a garage]

/memories/session-05.md:L21: [Image caption: a photography of a man working on a car engine in a garage]
/memories/session-05.md:L37: [Image caption: a photo of a red sports car driving down a road]
/memories/session-06.md:L25: [Image caption: a photo of a music studio with a keyboard, synthesizer, and other musical equipment]
/memories/session-06.md:L51: [Image caption: a photo of a city at night with a lot of lights]
/memories/session-07.md:L16: [Image caption: a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage]
/memories/session-07.md:L46: Dave: Wow, I bet it feels awesome. The connection between artist and audience must be so powerful. Look at the atmosphere in this photo, it's just off the charts!
/memories/session-07.md:L47: [Image caption: a photo of a large crowd of people taking pictures of a concert]
/memories/session-07.md:L51: [Image caption: a photo of a crowd of people watching a concert with bright lights]
/memories/session-07.md:L55: [Image caption: a photo of a concert with a band performing on stage]
/memories/session-07.md:L58: Calvin: Cool, can't wait for the tour with Frank! I'm buzzing to perform in Boston and see what it's like. Gonna be great playing for folks from home. What do you think of the music scene there?
/memories/session-07.md:L61: Dave: Hey, Boston's music scene is awesome! Tons of talented musicians and cool places to play. It'll be a blast performing there - I'll be there to cheer you on!
/memories/session-07.md:L67: Dave: Great, Calvin! Have a great time in Boston. Can't wait to hear all about it when you get back!
/memories/session-08.md:L16: [Image caption: a photography of a pond with a boat in it surrounded by trees]
/memories/session-08.md:L20: [Image caption: a photo of a recording studio with a large window and a desk]
/memories/session-08.md:L23: Dave: Hey, nice photo of the studio! Working in a team yields incredible results, well done! Keep pushing it! I've been doing good - thanks for asking. I've been exploring some parks on the weekends to relax - it's so peaceful being surrounded by nature. Are there any chill spots you enjoy in Boston?
/memories/session-08.md:L26: Calvin: Thanks! That studio is great for creativity. I've never been to Boston before, but I hear the parks are amazing. Can't wait to visit next month. Anything cool you remember about Boston parks?
/memories/session-08.md:L27: [Image caption: a photo of a tree with pink flowers in the foreground]
/memories/session-08.md:L30: Dave: That sounds great! The Boston parks are awesome, especially in spring. It's so serene when you're walking around. I went for a stroll last Friday and it was amazing. It's so magical - I bet you'll love it! I love taking walks on the weekends, they recharge me for the entire upcoming week!
/memories/session-08.md:L34: [Image caption: a photo of a path going up a hill with a view of the mountains]
/memories/session-08.md:L41: [Image caption: a photo of a plane flying over a mountain range with snow on the top]
/memories/session-09.md:L12: Calvin: Hi Dave! Nice to hear from you. Since last chat, some things have happened. I had a lil car accident last Friday, kinda upsetting but no one was hurt. I've been dealing with insurance and repairs - taking up a lot of time and energy. Look at this photo!
/memories/session-09.md:L13: [Image caption: a photo of a red car with a black rim parked on a sidewalk]
/memories/session-09.md:L20: [Image caption: a photo of a tow truck parked in a parking lot]
/memories/session-09.md:L26: Calvin: It only took a week to sort everything out. I was worried about the cost, but it wasn't too bad. Look at this photo from the auto repair shop. 
/memories/session-09.md:L27: [Image caption: a photography of a man working on a car in a garage]
/memories/session-09.md:L46: [Image caption: a photo of a view of a small town with a mountain in the background]
/memories/session-09.md:L59: [Image caption: a photo of a person on skis on a snowy mountain]
/memories/session-09.md:L68: Dave: Yes, Cal! I recently joined a rock band and have been practicing guitar. Look at this photo – it's us, the guys! 
/memories/session-09.md:L69: [Image caption: a photography of a group of men playing instruments in a room]
/memories/session-10.md:L16: [Image caption: a photography of a red sports car parked on the side of the road]
/memories/session-10.md:L26: Dave: Yeah, today we are going to that spot. Look at that lovely photo.
/memories/session-10.md:L27: [Image caption: a photo of a city skyline with a river and boats in the water]
/memories/session-10.md:L30: Calvin: Wow, what a view! That sunset over the river is gorgeous. It must be so tranquil there. Reminds me of living in my Japanese mansion with the epic cityscape. It's like a dream come true! Look at this photo I took from my backyard of the mansion. It's so beautiful!
/memories/session-10.md:L31: [Image caption: a photo of a boat is docked in a canal at sunset]
/memories/session-10.md:L38: [Image caption: a photo of a large house with a lot of windows and lights]
/memories/session-11.md:L19: [Image caption: a photography of a person riding a motorcycle down a dirt road]
/memories/session-11.md:L23: [Image caption: a photo of a room with a ladder and a ladder in it]
/memories/session-12.md:L28: [Image caption: a photography of a man and a child pose for a picture]
/memories/session-12.md:L32: [Image caption: a photography of a red car is lifted on a lift in a garage]
/memories/session-12.md:L44: Calvin: My plan for now is to expand my brand worldwide and grow my fanbase. I want my music to reach more people and make an impact. Working with artists from around the globe and challenging myself to create special music are goals of mine too. Look at the photo of how I performed with the boys last night, they are great at the music!
/memories/session-12.md:L45: [Image caption: a photo of a band playing on stage with lights on]
/memories/session-13.md:L13: [Image caption: a photography of a man standing in front of a car on a lift]
/memories/session-13.md:L26: [Image caption: a photo of a car is being worked on by a mechanic]
/memories/session-13.md:L33: [Image caption: a photo of a silver corvette parked in front of a building]
/memories/session-13.md:L58: [Image caption: a photo of a desk with a keyboard, monitor, and keyboard pad]
/memories/session-14.md:L34: [Image caption: a photography of a crowd of people at a concert with their hands up]
/memories/session-14.md:L44: [Image caption: a photo of a car with a broken engine in the woods]
/memories/session-15.md:L12: Dave: Hey Calvin! Haven't talked in a while! Last Friday I had a card-night with my friends, it was so much fun. We laughed and had a great time! Take a look at the photo!
/memories/session-15.md:L13: [Image caption: a photography of a group of men sitting at a table with playing cards]
/memories/session-15.md:L28: Calvin: It was an incredible experience, Dave! The city was buzzing with energy and the festival crowd was so lively - it was like fuel for my soul. Look at this photo, that's amazing!
/memories/session-15.md:L29: [Image caption: a photo of a crowd of people sitting on the grass at night]

/memories/session-02.md:L34: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Doing good. Last weekend, I went to a music festival in Boston - it was awesome! So many cool bands playing and the atmosphere was electric. I love music, it reminded me why I love it. Here's a pic, take a look.
/memories/session-02.md:L64: Calvin: Got a new ride and wrote some new tunes - had a few studio sessions last week and I'm excited to collaborate. Can't wait to share it with everyone!
/memories/session-03.md:L46: Dave: Last weekend I went to a car show. Classic cars are so charming and the dedication people put into restoring them is amazing. That's why I'm so into auto engineering. Can't wait to show you some when you come to Boston! Oh, almost forgot to send a photo, look at this beautiful car!
/memories/session-06.md:L18: Calvin: Hey Dave, not everything has been going smoothly. I had an incident last week where my place got flooded, but thankfully, I managed to save my music gear and favorite microphone. It's been tough, but I'm staying positive and looking forward to getting everything fixed up.
/memories/session-06.md:L34: Dave: I'm so excited, I opened my car shop last week! Invited some friends over to celebrate and it's been amazing. Super stoked to share my passion and help out with folks' rides. It's been incredible so far.
/memories/session-07.md:L12: Calvin: Hey Dave! Been ages since we chatted. So much has gone down. Touring with Frank Ocean last week was wild. Tokyo was unreal -- the crowd was insane. I felt so alive when performing, can't find the words to express it.
/memories/session-16.md:L29: Calvin: Cool! Last weekend I started shooting a video for my new album - can't wait for you to check it out! Look how great it was!
/memories/session-17.md:L27: Calvin: Wow, Dave, that's awesome! You should be really proud of yourself for bringing joy to others. I booked a flight ticket to Boston last week! I'm so excited about my upcoming trip to Boston. Look at this! See you soon, buddy!
/memories/session-19.md:L12: Dave: Hey Calvin! Long time no talk! Got some cool news to share - last night was a blast! My band and I were jamming and the music just kept flowing. We had so much fun rehearsing! Also, last weekend, I had the opportunity to attend a rock concert here in Boston. Just take a look at what an amazing atmosphere it was!
/memories/session-23.md:L58: Calvin: C'mon, remember how great you are! Keep going for those dreams. You got this! You know what Dave? Last week, I got a new Ferrari! It's a masterpiece on wheels. Excited for thrilling rides and unforgettable journeys! Perhaps a photo of this unique beauty will lift your mood.
/memories/session-25.md:L89: Dave: Glad you like it, Cal! It reminds me of the good times I've had at concerts last month. Music has a way of connecting us and making memories. Take a look at this picture, the atmosphere was amazing!
/memories/session-27.md:L28: Dave: That's Boston, Cal! Check this out, I took this picture last month, and got a great shot - it was stunning!
/memories/session-28.md:L12: Calvin: Hey Dave! It's been a while! Crazy stuff has been happening. Last week I threw a small party at my Japanese house for my new album. It was amazing, so much love from my fam and friends! Take a look at the photo of the party in the mansion, it was so energizing!
/memories/session-28.md:L81: Dave: I found it last week, and it was in bad shape, but I saw the potential. I spent ages restoring it.
/memories/session-30.md:L55: Dave: I totally agree, nature really can boost our spirits in tough times. Also, here's a picture I snapped last week! It's a peaceful scene with rocks and a waterfall. Pretty cool, huh?
